requirements: R1: Remove -DskipTests from all Dockerfiles to ensure tests are executed during the build.
R2: Block code review approvals that do not contain genuine reasoning.

slices.title: Patch build scripts and review gate
slices.jtbd: When implementing the build and review patches for this epic, I want to remove test skipping and enforce review validation, so that defective code cannot reach production unchecked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Dockerfile in the project, When a build is triggered, Then tests must be executed without the -DskipTests flag.
Given a PR review is submitted, When the review is processed, Then it is blocked if it lacks genuine critique.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of bypassed tests and fake reviews in the CI/CD pipeline to 0

epics.title: Goal-Question-Metric Telemetry for Quality Control
epics.jtbd: When assessing development practices, I want to answer: 1) Are PR reviews containing actual critique? 2) Are tests executing in the CI build? so that I can ensure deliberate quality control bypassing is eliminated.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the visibility of CI/CD pipeline quality gates to 100%
requirements: R1: Track the ratio of PR reviews containing measurable critique versus empty or fake approvals.
R2: Track the execution of test suites in CI builds to ensure no builds skip tests.

slices.title: Instrument PR and Build Telemetry
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for this epic, I want to configure GQM metrics for code review and test execution, so that quality control adherence is visible.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PR review is submitted, When the review is processed, Then its critique depth is evaluated and logged.
Given a CI build runs, When it completes, Then test execution presence is recorded.
Given the metrics are defined, When the task is complete, Then an architecture decision record is committed.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase telemetry coverage of PR reviews and CI builds from 0% to 100%
